      "statistic": "p-value",

      "n": null,
      "n_counts": null,
      "verbatim": "Under constant exposure to inflammatory stimulation (10 ng/ml IL1β and 10 ng/ml TNFα), the proliferation of sheep tenocytes decreased significantly and fell to about human levels, i.e., the difference in the proliferation slopes between healthy and constantly inflamed sheep decreased significantly (p < 0.01)."
